title: Luce: Relightable Gaussians for 3D Asset Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.23943v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: High-fidelity image-to-3D generation requires a 3D representation that captures both geometry and appearance. To support relighting and integration into standard rendering pipelines, the representation should include physically based rendering (PBR) modalities such as albedo, metallic-roughness, and surface normals. We propose Luce, a 3D representation that unifies geometry and PBR materials within a voxelized multimodal Gaussian cloud, using dedicated Gaussian primitives for each modality. A variational autoencoder compresses this representation into a unified material-aware latent space. A rectified-flow transformer generates this latent from a single image, conditioned on multi-layer features from a pretrained image encoder that preserve both semantic context and fine spatial detail. translated_title: Luce：用于3D资产生成的可重新照明高斯模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.23943v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：高保真图像到3D生成需要一种能够捕捉几何和外观的3D表示。为了支持重新照明并集成到标准渲染管线中，该表示应包含基于物理的渲染（PBR）模态，如反照率、金属粗糙度和表面法线。我们提出了Luce，一种3D表示，它在体素化的多模态高斯云中统一了几何和PBR材质，并为每种模态使用专用的高斯原语。一个变分自编码器将此表示压缩为统一的材质感知潜在空间。一个修正流变压器从单张图像生成此潜在表示，基于预训练图像编码器的多层特征进行条件化，这些特征保留了语义上下文和精细空间细节。该潜在表示随后解码为可重新照明的PBR高斯以及一个带有切线空间法线贴图的可选纹理网格。在Toys4K上，Luce达到了最先进的性能。
tldr: Luce提出了一种统一的体素化多模态高斯表示，结合变分自编码器和修正流变压器，实现从单张图像生成可重新照明的PBR材质和网格，并在Toys4K数据集上达到最先进性能。
en_tdlr: Luce introduces a unified voxelized multimodal Gaussian representation, coupled with a variational autoencoder and rectified-flow transformer, to generate relightable PBR materials and meshes from a single image, achieving state-of-the-art performance on Toys4K.
